The '''BX-333 Biorecorder''' looked like a basic [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]], but it was capable of extremely detailed recording. It measured the heart rate, blood pressure, and other vital signs of anyone recording a message with it. As a result, the messages were much more detailed and nuanced. It was said that viewing a message made by a BX-333 was just like seeing a person live.
